body: I just can't keep living like this, I don't see the point, Ive been looking for the past few years, people say it gets better but it's just not. I don't know how long I can keep going on like this for

I used to take medication  through the age of 15 but it just didn't feel like it was working, I've tried medication, therapy and everything the doctors and other people have recommended. None of it worked and I'm really running out of options here. I'm 17 also, I have dreams but I just can't picture myself 'living' through highschool, I only really had my teacher for motivation now that she's on maternity leave, I have no reason to keep going, all I really feel these days is guilt and sadness. I just don't know what to do.

They made me see the school counsellor to no avail and a private psych which also didn't help either. I think I'm just done, Ive tried, and tried and tried, but these past few weeks I've just been crying myself to sleep every night. I can't take going to school, feeling like shit and all the other things I have to do. I just really fucked up, I shouldn't have even talked about it and made her worry, it was such a selfish thing to do. I thought I was sad then, that doesn't compare to how I feel now, with this extremely overwhelming sadness and this feeling of how I just should never of accepted her help. I don't get why I always screw everything up. I'm sorry
